hypotheses: Representation: retain eight ordered low/body/upper power observations relative to pre-candidate background, alongside the frozen15 features; keep regularised linear scorer unchanged.

fixed: Same candidates,40ms horizon rounded up to hop boundary,60ms refractory, labels, song/class/event weighting, nested song exclusions and coarse-plus-one-refinement cutoff protocol. One configuration per hypothesis; no additional search.
acceptance: At least166/174 matched within70ms and no more than8 unmatched on the reference pack, >=90% recall each track, allfourkickfreecoreszero; expandedlocalcorpus and reservedvalidation ALSO required. Neither this reference result nor its absence proves generalisation.
limitations: Exploratory nine-song development only. Provisional labels, no reserved validation yet. SVD residuals and logistic scores are not calibrated probabilities. Possible duplicates are temporal associations, not source identifications. CPU timings are offline throughput, not native callback guarantees. No extra observation delay, GPU or live integration. Possible-duplicate counts use core-matched labels and may undercount master-boundary duplicates.
decision: Neither fixed hypothesis improves the best reference tradeoff. Currentgoal targets not achieved; expand local development evidence before next hypothesis. Two materially different hypotheses tested in this goal run, both unsuccessful; plateau stop threshold is three.

score_complementarity.method: Diagnostic union of independently matched label identities at70ms from two fixed nested threshold outputs. Not a runnable combined detector or a bound for rematching their combined event streams. No new scores, labels or fitting; continuous subthreshold scores retain additional information.

supported_findings: All174 labelled events have a raw available candidate within70ms; Midnight116.96s has only excluded timely availability. This does not assert a174-event one-to-one ceiling.

Primary missed-label attribution: linear79 cutoff rejections+1 uncertainty exclusion; SVD90 cutoff rejections+1 uncertainty exclusion+1 one-to-one competition. Zero genuine missing-candidate or primary refractory-suppression misses.
Linear Bad Guy:26 wide-unmatched emitted triggers; median score0.999778 versus0.999219 median best-score labelled event. Merely increasing its cutoff cannot separate these overlapping rankings.
SVD rank2 explains57.2–60.7% of weighted positive training variance and46.7–53.7% negative variance. Basis overlap statistic spans0.594–0.697; this measures shared directions, not class separability.

SVD Miracle: median positive-basis reconstruction fraction is0.185 for labelled-event best candidates versus0.773 for emitted wide extras. Corresponding median scores0.582 versus0.648; the learned low-rank geometry favours these unmatched events.

Pooled reviewed-candidate trajectory adjacent median correlation:low0.598,body0.829,upper0.911. No pooled trajectory/trajectory or trajectory/base15 pair exceeds|r|=.95; trajectory/base maximum=.760. Broad feature redundancy is not established.
These are diagnostic associations against provisional labels. They do not identify acoustic sources of unmatched triggers or prove why a particular timbre differs.
failure_diagnosis.qualification: Diagnosis of the original frozen models, before the training-exclusion repair. Candidate coverage means temporal availability, not proof that a kick caused the candidate. High candidate AUC does not establish event precision at high recall.

training_target_audit.interpretation: These targets supervise candidate-start proximity, not whether a kick is observable by the deadline or whether an emission meets70ms. Late positives and early negative straddles demonstrate a mismatch in target semantics; early positives also have unequal evidence ages. The audit cannot establish that correcting it improves detection, excluded candidate windows were never fitted as negatives, but excluded truth labels can still assign positives after an excluded region because truth itself is not filtered. No target, label, or model was changed.
training_target_audit.correction: Ignore candidates within35ms of excluded/out-of-core truth instead of retaining them as positive targets or relabelling them negative. Stored labels, scoring and old model results remain unchanged. Early/late target timing is diagnosed, not changed by this repair.

expanded_review_preparation.status: Source proposals require individual review: inspected cases include decay-tail recrossings and near-stationary weak source noise. Five exactly silent source cores are not automatically negative master labels.

measurement_followup.conclusion: No raw-signal information limit demonstrated. Fix target consistency and complete independent annotation before choosing another measurement or score.
measurement_followup.prior_local_evidence: Steady RMS/quadrature, complex-domain novelty and timbre-template trials already exist; do not repeat them as new hypotheses. SVD reconstruction of dominant variance does not guarantee kick/non-kick discrimination.

research.lesson: Phase/magnitude prediction error measures onset novelty; source identity requires additional evidence. Existing local complex-domain audit already tested this direction.

Time-dynamic spectral templates support real-time drum decomposition, but this paper uses drum recordings and expected-instrument training. It does not establish generalisation to arbitrary mastered mixes.
Separate attack and tail modelling is relevant to duplicate/renewal confusion. Reported improvements are on its own drum system, not a prediction for MANIFOLD.

training_exclusion_repair.validation: Eight focused fusion tests and two runner integration tests pass. Lead reviewed patch, reproduction script, source hashes and aggregate summaries.
training_exclusion_repair.decision: Correctness repair preserved; neither tested hypothesis improves the prototype sufficiently. Two failed research hypotheses remain; this repair is not a third hypothesis. No live change or success claim.
